Reconnected the preserved Next AdminConsole channel table and editor. Admin APIs list safe channel projections and support discovery/create/edit/enable/disable/delete across platform and workspace channels, with administrator and same-origin checks; integration tests verify non-admin denial, cross-origin rejection and persisted status changes.

Reconnected the preserved Next AdminConsole group UI, including create/edit/disable/delete dialogs, derived model/channel counts and routing inspection. Go admin APIs expose safe channel projections and ability/route layers with permission checks; billing integration tests verify group ratios. BrowserOS created a Chinese group, reloaded the deep link to confirm persistence, and inspected a model route with its priority, weight and 100% share; 390px viewport has no horizontal overflow.

Restored the legacy AdminConsole overview with live channel counts, active model counts by group, usage totals and the current Go relay timeout/pricing configuration. The admin-only endpoint reads SQLite and runtime configuration; integration tests cover metrics, the 24-hour window, currency conversion and member denial.

Restored the preserved AdminTools price table with token/cache, per-call and video-per-second modes. Go persists integer USD-micro rates, serves currency-adjusted reads, validates mutually exclusive modes and applies configured prices with request-time snapshots during reservation and settlement. Tests cover admin permission/origin checks, malformed combinations and token/per-call/video charges. BrowserOS saved Chinese token prices, reloaded the deep link to verify persistence, and confirmed no document overflow at 390px.

Restored live Go relay controls and admin-only SMTP settings with encrypted password storage and test-email action; SMTP tests cover role/origin checks, validation, ciphertext secrecy, restart persistence and local-server delivery. Password recovery now uses this SMTP transport with enumeration-safe responses, HMAC-protected codes, expiry, attempt cap, rate limits and session revocation.

Reconnected the preserved AdminTools user table. Admin-only Go APIs list account roles, personal-wallet balances, usage totals and last-use timestamps; role updates protect the final administrator, balance changes convert the configured display currency into USD micros, preserve held reservations and create wallet-ledger entries. Integration tests cover permissions, origin, role constraints, reservation limits and ledger consistency.

Mounted the preserved settings route; account name/email load from the authenticated Go account API, and notification preferences persist in a user-scoped table with same-origin writes and strict preference-key validation. Integration tests cover anonymous access, cross-origin rejection, invalid preferences and persistence. The screen labels email delivery as unavailable; no delivery is claimed.

Restored the localized recovery page and wired it to Go endpoints. Codes are six-digit, HMAC-protected, expire after 15 minutes, permit at most five attempts, and rate-limit by email and source IP; responses avoid account enumeration. Password changes revoke all sessions. Go tests cover enumeration, code rejection, attempt cap, one-time reset and session revocation; frontend production build passes.

BrowserOS verified localized desktop/mobile routes, required-field and email validation, a draft containing name/email/company/topic/message, and the send-another reset; 390px mobile layouts have no document overflow.
